goal: Rewrite ZernioBackfillWorker as the consented Review import executor: select the newest 100 reviews inside the Import window (12-month floor, below the live-ingest cutoff), answered and unanswered alike, store them as list rows via importReview with nothing auto-drafted (D2), page until the target is met failing loudly on cap exhaustion, and write only the collapsed imported_count/skipped_count.
non_goals: Import consent gate in the worker (spec §5.3 accepted-only pre-flight) — owned by #679
Consent gates at the three enqueue sites — owned by #676
Prompt UI / decision API / importing state — owned by #677
Reviews list surface, unanswered-first sort, per-row Generate/Regenerate — owned by #678
Dropping the four legacy gap_*/historical_* counters — owned by #680 (this ticket only freezes them at DEFAULT 0 for new runs)
Renaming the zernio_initial_backfill topic / zernio_backfill_runs table (map #667 out-of-scope)
KPI treatment of imported reviews — accepted as-is now; pre-GA decision ticket #688 filed on map #667
Any migration or schema change (run-semantics discriminator resolved as deploy-timestamp comment on #680 at promotion)
Any behavior change to processReview's live-ingest lane, including the live lane's flag-gated eventual-convergence reconcile behavior
user_visible_behavior: Subscribe+connect no longer auto-drafts replies from review history: an accepted import stores reviews and generates nothing, sends no notifications
An import stores up to 100 newest reviews within 12 months; answered reviews appear with their existing Google reply (posted response row), unanswered reviews appear with no response
Reviews arriving at or after connect keep getting automatic drafts via the live lane — 'new reviews are still handled automatically' holds structurally (disjoint lane ownership)
Dashboard KPIs (review volume MoM, sentiment trend week, response rate) visibly move on import — accepted and documented, revisit before GA (#688)
invariants: Disjoint lane ownership: the import selects only reviews with createTime < connected_at − grace (exact complement of isRecentForConnection); the live lane owns everything at or after it — the #674 lost-draft hazard is structurally impossible
Nothing the import stores can reach Google: importReview writes no job_outbox row (architecture invariant #3)

The import is insert-only for review rows the live lane owns — it never mutates such a row; superseding a stale local draft on an import-owned answered review (reconcile branch 3) stores the external posted reply in the same transaction

New runs write ONLY imported_count/skipped_count (+ oldest_skipped_create_time) of the counter set being collapsed; the four legacy gap_*/historical_* counters freeze at DEFAULT 0 — the #673 dual-write contract ends here. The fifth, pre-existing external_reply_ingested_count legitimately increments on answered imports (r1 triage: it is not part of the F2 freeze)

Accepted-but-incomplete runs stay retryable: completed_at IS NULL sentinel and idempotent re-entry unchanged (spec §5.1); a cap-exhausted run fails terminally with completed_at NULL and stays claimable after an ops cap bump
Defensive re-sort kept; a fetched page arriving non-descending logs a warning and disables BOTH early stops (target and floor) for that run (spec §9 caveat)
The consented lane imports answered reviews unconditionally — EXTERNAL_REPLY_IMPORT_ENABLED continues to govern only the live lane's posture
Transactional outbox discipline unchanged; markOutboxCompleted only after the run's terminal write
edge_cases: connected_at NULL → poller owns nothing → import applies no upper cutoff (complementarity preserved)
No active zernio_connections row at run time → skip-as-success: complete the outbox row with a logged reason, leave completed_at NULL
Fewer than 100 reviews in the window → import what exists; zero → run completes successfully with imported_count = 0
Ordering violation (non-descending page) → warning log + BOTH early stops disabled for that run (pages to feed end or cap; a dirty cap-out with ≥100 candidates proceeds best-effort)

Page cap exhausted with nextPageToken set and target unmet → TERMINAL: markOutboxFailed with the ZernioImportPaginationCapExhaustedError message + Sentry capture, completed_at left NULL — never truncate silently, never retry-churn a deterministic condition
Reviews repeated across page boundaries → deduplicated by review id (imported and counted once)

PHI or malformed unanswered reviews in the selection → skipped (PHI exception row as today), counted in skipped_count; answered PHI routes through reconciliation (no worker-side pre-screen) and counts imported
Rows already ingested live → importReview returns 'unchanged' → counted in imported_count (present in the list)
Answered import-owned review with a stale non-matching active draft → draft superseded AND external posted reply stored in the same reconcile transaction (consented lane only)
Reconcile failure on an answered review → collect and throw at end so BullMQ retries the whole idempotent run
Retry days later → window anchored at run-time NOW(); the floor is recomputed each attempt
Reactivation runs (run_reason='reactivation') use the identical selection; correlation-keyed idempotency unchanged
